summary: Bounded remediation of the already-published src/content/blog/beginner/rascettes-palmistry.md, addressing the single defect Independent Director review rejected after revision 1 was merged out of band as PR #105: the 'Palmistry Path's approach' section's sentence asserting that 'no consistent relationship between palm markings and outcomes like lifespan has been established' was a broad empirical/scientific claim not supported by .ai-ops/evidence/PP-RELAY-058-benham-rascettes-boundary.md or any other approved source in this task.
